name: Dorothy Ann Wheeler (Allen)
notable_stories: A talented musician who won a scholarship the same day she became a bride
Her children include Wendy, Susan, William, Anthony, and Brooks

She won a scholarship and became a bride on the same day. She had often played the organ at other people's weddings, but at her own someone else played, and she wore the veil her mother had worn at her wedding.
milestones: Married George Homer Allen (m. 8 May 1944, Sioux Falls, SD)
education: Was offered a music scholarship by the Eastman School of Music on the morning of her wedding; she might accept it if Lt. Allen was sent overseas, and planned to continue her musical studies after the war
career: Talented young musician who had played the organ at many weddings (1944)
